name: Braino
tagline: Shared, governed knowledge for teams and AI agents
description: Search, brief, read, and maintain your team's decisions, rules, evidence, and work history with provenance. The hosted Braino MCP server uses OAuth and only exposes workspaces and collections granted to the connection.

install.notes: Complete the browser OAuth flow, then call braino_whoami to review the workspaces and collections granted to Cline.
